entries.title: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff says AI won’t kill entry-level jobs. He’s hiring 1,000 new grads to prove it
entries.summary: The billionaire said the SaaS giant would hire recent grads to help build its AI platforms.

entries.title: United Airlines CEO says a proposed merger would benefit travelers, but American still won’t return his calls
entries.summary: The stocks of both airlines soared two weeks ago when reports surfaced that Kirby had floated the idea of combining two of the biggest U.S. airlines to the White House.

entries.title: Iran offers to reopen Strait of Hormuz amid oil price surge, but Trump seems unlikely to accept
entries.summary: With a fragile ceasefire in place, the U.S. and Iran are locked in a standoff over the strait, through which a fifth of the world’s traded oil and gas passes in peacetime.

entries.title: ‘Capitalism works because the losers die’: Kevin O’Leary says it’s a ‘really bad idea’ for the federal government to bail out Spirit Airlines
entries.summary: The Shark Tank star and multimillionaire investor says the Trump administration's reported $500 million rescue plan props up "bad management" and undermines the free market.

entries.title: Daughter of former Uzbek president accused of masterminding $100 million crime ring known as ‘The Office’
entries.summary: Swiss prosecutors say Karimova developed and ran a crime ring known as “The Office” that involved several dozen people and multiple companies.

entries.title: Incoming Apple CEO John Ternus tells Gen Z an early mistake taught him an important lesson: ‘The care you put into your work really matters’
entries.summary: John Ternus, the incoming CEO of Apple, advises Gen Z college graduates to pour themselves into work, build skills, and always assume they’re not the smartest in the room.

entries.title: Apple cofounder Ronald Wayne—whose stake would be worth up to $400 billion had he not sold it in 1976—says that at 91, he has no regrets
entries.summary: Ronald Wayne helped Steve Jobs and Steve Wozniak create Apple—but sold out just 12 days in. He never became a billionaire, but tells Fortune he has no regrets.

entries.title: Shell reverses course in Canada and buys ARC Resources for $14 billion, doubling down on oil and gas
entries.summary: The Montney is emerging as a hot oil and gas play as the U.S. shale basins mature.

entries.title: A bank robber made off with $195,000 and got caught after his cell pinged a geofence. Now SCOTUS decides whether that violated the Fourth Amendment
entries.summary: Police went to Okello Chatrie's house after his cell phone was among the devices within the vicinity of the bank at the time of the robbery.

entries.title: Intel’s share price just blew the doors off. One man thinks he knows the reason why
entries.summary: Written off as a legacy chipmaker, Intel is staging a comeback—riding the AI boom, forging alliances, and betting big on a future it once failed to see
